name: Shinozaki Takumi
source:
Has a mild-mannered, go with the flow type personality. He hasn't quite realized his being a mothercon, but he loves to be spoiled.
Once he learned that his friend Eita was after his mother, he began to awaken to his mother complex.
Longs after his friend Eita's mother.

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1018080&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
